content.comment_body: My helpful [company_name] representative provided me with a sample of the latest [product_name] [article_no] unit. The refreshed interface and screens are impressive, and it reads and writes programs from previous [version_no] models seamlessly. Everything works great, except there seems to be no option to stop a running program once it's loaded. The SETUP menu includes a 'switch to ADMIN' feature, but I am unsure of the password, as my program does not use one. I tried leaving the field blank and entering 'ADMIN' in various cases, but nothing worked. Does anyone know what the default password might be?
The password is actually 'LOGO'. Who would have guessed?
Unfortunately, 'LOGO' is not granting me access to my [product_name] 8 system. Can anyone provide assistance? Thank you.
What is the IP address and subnet mask of your PC or laptop? What are the IP address and subnet mask for your [product_name]? Are you connecting directly or through a router?

I'm connecting through a router. The [product_name] uses the default subnet, but I’m not sure about the PC’s network settings since I haven’t configured it before. I can access the system at the 192.168... range, but I’m unable to log in as admin, which means I can only modify the program on the local network—where the admin password isn’t required—not remotely via the internet. Thanks for your help.
Your explanation isn’t clear. Are you able to connect to your [product_name] at all, or only to your home network?

I've tried using 'LOGO', but it doesn’t work. I can only access the [product_name] TD via browser to adjust parameters like duration time or switch on/off. I’d like to connect to the [product_name] to fully modify the program with [product_name] software if possible. I really appreciate all your help and patience!

analysis.insight_summary: Users see value in the improved interface and backward compatibility of the updated [product_name] hardware and software. However, several users are struggling to access admin functionality, which is essential for remote programming and stopping/modifying active programs, particularly over network connections. There is ongoing confusion about the default admin password and proper network configuration, and users are limited to basic parameter edits without admin access.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a straightforward method to obtain admin rights for comprehensive device management and remote programming capabilities, including stopping or modifying active programs. They also want clear, accessible documentation for default credentials and network setup.
